newsitem.title: CHINA: China gives Jiangling Auto export licence.
newsitem.headline: China gives Jiangling Auto export licence.

text.p: China has given domestic automaker Jiangling Motors Corp permission to export its products, the Xinhua news agency said on Monday.
The China Quality Authentication of Import and Export Commodities granted Jiangling an "export quality passport" recently, Xinhua said, but gave no further details.
Jiangling, in the eastern province of Jiangxi, is one of China's major auto manufacturers. It produces 120,000 light trucks each year.
Last month, Lear Corp, a unit of U.S. carmaker Ford Motor Co, said it would form a $30 million joint venture with Jiangling to make car and light-truck interior components.
Ford holds about 20 percent of Jiangling's capital in both A and B shares, Xinhua said.
